$comment: Lighthouse CI on a production build against the local mock API (scripts/lighthouse-local.sh; the lighthouse job in ci.yml): the form page and a case page, as the E2E job runs them. Previews have no API until the backend exists (ADR-0005). Mobile preset (Lighthouse default: simulated slow 4G, 4x CPU), median of 3 runs. LCP per ADR-0003 as amended by the user's decision of 2026-10-04 (v1 goal: LCP <= 2.5 s at p75 on real users): warn above 2500 ms, fail above 3000 ms, median run, on every URL. LHCI allows one assertion per audit key, so assertMatrix has two entries matching all URLs: the LCP warning, and the LCP error with every other assertion. CLS from ADR-0003; category scores from frontend-qa-conventions.md § Accessibility & Performance Gates. ADR-0003 is owned by the Frontend Architect: change thresholds only through the plan or an ADR, never to turn CI green. The URLs come from the script.
